text:
Type: wooden bar stool with backrest
Use: seating at a kitchen island, bar or high counter; kitchen, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: solid birch with a clear lacquer finish, dark grey metal footbar
Colors: pale natural birch, dark grey
Shape: tall frame with a flat panel backrest between two posts, square seat with a deep apron, long straight legs with low side stretchers, slim footbar, upright and light
Feel: natural, calm, honest, casual
Goes with: white or light wood counters, white tiles, black fixtures; Scandinavian, Japandi or farmhouse kitchens
